_readme: THIS IS THE FILE TO EDIT to change the Team section.
TO ADD A WORK TITLE: find the person below and type it into their
"title" field. That is the only edit needed — the page picks it up on
the next load. Until a title is filled in, the card shows a muted
"Work title to be added" placeholder rather than a guess.
TO ADD OR REMOVE A MEMBER: add or delete an entry in "members". The
order here is the order shown on the page.
WHAT THIS SECTION SHOWS: name and work title, nothing else. No bios,
no photos, no skills, no profile links, no personal contact details —
that is deliberate, not unfinished. Everyone reaches the team through
the contact form, which goes to the address in CONTACT_TO
Titles are never invented. If a title is not in this file, it is
because nobody has supplied it yet.

meta.tagline: Built by students who are passionate about technology, learning, and career development.
